verdict.rationale: Sentry's docs say it can ingest OpenTelemetry traces and logs over OTLP endpoints, either directly from an OTel SDK or through the OpenTelemetry Collector. That means code instrumented once with OTel can point at Sentry, or be re-routed elsewhere, without re-instrumenting. Missing for 10: OTLP ingestion of metrics and errors is not evidenced, there is no documentation on feature parity between OTel data and Sentry's native SDK, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of backend switching.
